globalShortcut.title: Global shortcut
globalShortcut.description: Bring the window to the front from any app.
globalShortcut.footnote: Off by default: a system-wide shortcut takes priority over other apps. Supports Alt / Option / CommandOrControl / Shift combined with letters or function keys.

enableShortcut.label: Enable global shortcut
enableShortcut.description: The combination below is registered with the system only when enabled.

launchOnStartup.label: Launch at login
launchOnStartup.description: Start the app when you sign in to macOS.

keepOnTop.label: Always on top
keepOnTop.description: Keep the window above other apps.

closeToTray.label: Hide to tray on close
closeToTray.description: Keep the process running; click the Dock icon to bring it back.

language.title: Language
language.description: Switch the interface language, applied immediately.

settings.title: Settings

fontSize.title: Body text size
fontSize.description: Affects conversation text only, not UI dimensions.

codeFont.title: Code font
codeFont.description: Used by code blocks, the Artifacts code view and the message input.

chatWidth.title: Conversation width
chatWidth.description: Max width of the content column; affects long tables and code blocks.

preview.title: Size preview
preview.body: Preview: Rust rules out data races at compile time with the borrow checker, no runtime GC needed.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Every shortcut below is wired to a real action.

sendKey.title: Send key
sendKey.description: Key combination that submits a message; Shift + Enter always inserts a newline.

drafts.label: Keep drafts
drafts.description: Remember unsent input when switching conversations.

download.title: Download folder
download.description: Artifacts exports and code downloads are saved here.
download.footnote: Supports the ~ prefix; the folder is created when missing.

reset.title: Reset local data
reset.description: Deletes every conversation, message and draft. API keys live in the system keychain and are unaffected.
reset.confirmBody: This removes every conversation stored on this device and cannot be undone.

system.label: System notification
system.description: Send a macOS notification when a reply finishes while the window is in the background.

sound.label: Completion sound
sound.description: Play a short chime when generation ends.

projects.title: Global system prompt
projects.description: Injected as the system message on every request to keep tone and format consistent.
projects.footnote: Leave empty to send no system message. Changes apply immediately.
projects.placeholder: For example: always answer in Simplified Chinese and label code blocks.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter (recommended)
openrouter.description: One key for hundreds of models — Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek — including free endpoints.

deepseek.title: DeepSeek direct
deepseek.description: Low latency, low cost, native thinking-mode toggle.

openai.title: OpenAI direct
openai.description: Talk to the official OpenAI endpoint.

custom.title: Local / self-hosted
custom.description: Any OpenAI-compatible service, e.g. Ollama, vLLM or LM Studio.

providers.keychainNote: Keys are stored in the macOS keychain, never in the WebView localStorage.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Controls how much the model thinks before answering.

thinking.label: Enable deep thinking
thinking.description: When off, the model answers directly with lower latency.

effort.label: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Changing this applies the matching thinking-token budget.

descriptions.deepseek_v4_pro: DeepSeek's flagship model with 1M context for hard reasoning and planning

descriptions.anthropic_claude_3_5_haiku: Anthropic's lightweight model for low-latency chat and summarization
descriptions.openai_gpt_4o: OpenAI's flagship multimodal model, balanced across vision and general tasks
descriptions.openai_o3_mini: OpenAI's small reasoning model with cheaper math and code reasoning
